title: Tingley extension for real Banach spaces
exact_target: For any nonzero real Banach spaces X and Y, must every surjective isometry from the unit sphere of X onto the unit sphere of Y extend to a unique surjective real-linear isometry $X->Y$?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.

manuscripts.title: A positive solution to Tingley's problem
